_comment: Copy to risk.json and edit. Remove a key or set it to null to turn a rule off. Day = UTC day. These numbers fit together: $100 margin x 10x = $1,000 position; a 2% stop on it risks $20 (2% of a $1,000 account); $60/day = three losing trades. Futures: 1 MNQ x 10-pt stop x $2/pt = $20 risk; 1 MES x 4-pt stop x $5/pt = $20. NQ ($20/pt) is left off allowed_symbols on purpose: one NQ contract with a 10-pt stop risks $200.
